adds.after: # DetailTemplate type:image suffix mismatch blocks extensionless image display DetailTemplate's type:'image' only renders when the suffix matches jpg/jpeg/png/gif/bmp/webp/svg; extensionless internal addresses are misjudged as attachment links and not displayed. ## Root Cause - Original logic decides whether to render or an attachment link by a file-suffix whitelist (jpg/jpeg/png/gif/bmp/webp/svg) - Extensionless internal resource addresses match no suffix and are treated as attachment links, so images fail to display ## Solution - Change the type from type:'image' to type:'images' - Add a computed property stepPictureUrlList that provides a URL array - Let resolveServerAssetUrl directly concatenate for display, no longer relying on suffix matching ## Verification and Attribution - Verification: session 321b7eb6 conclusion, src=产品2.0/057.md - Involved files: zhi2-web-admin/src/views/dataProperty/scrappedRecord/detail.vue、src/mixins/detailMixins.js、src/views/maintenance/facility/components/FacilitySelectDialog.vue、src/mixins/form.js、src/views/dataProperty/recordProcess/components/detail.vue、src/views/property/complexDeliveryApply/components/facilityDialog.vue、src/views/maintenance/repair/detail.vue、src/views/dataProperty/recordProcess/components/recordProcessStepDialog.vue - Project: 产品2.0; source session: 321b7eb6-d1b4-4f6b-865c-11661215d619; code baseline: none

# spFeeBill/import custom 5-minute timeout
The global default 100-second timeout cannot satisfy the long-running /property/spFeeBill/import requirement, so the timeout must be overridden per request.

## Background
- The global request default timeout is 100 seconds, while the spFeeBill batch import interface takes far longer
- Without overriding the timeout, large imports are interrupted midway

## Solution
- Add IMPORT_REQUEST_TIMEOUT = 5 * 60 * 1000 (5 minutes) in enums.js
- Pass timeout in the request config of import.vue and importUploadDialog.vue to override the default
- Reuse the existing timeout prompt logic; no new error-handling logic needed

# el-upload :limit=1 再选文件替换须走 on-exceed
上传组件设 :limit="1" 后再次选文件走 on-exceed 而非 on-change，替换逻辑必须挂在 on-exceed 上。

## 问题根因
- Element UI 在文件数已达 limit 时再选文件走 on-exceed 回调，根本不会进入 on-change
- 挂在 on-change 上的替换/去重逻辑永远收不到新文件，这是 limit 生效后的必然行为而非组件 bug

## 解决方案
- 新增 handleExceed(files)：取 files[0]，先做与 on-change 相同的 validateFile 校验
- 然后 this.$refs.upload.clearFiles() 清空组件内部列表并重置 fileList/localFiles
- 最后手动调用 this.$refs.upload.handleStart(file) 把新文件重新加入上传流程（handleStart 是 el-upload 实例方法，非公开 API 但稳定）
- 凡「限 1 个文件 + 重新选择即替换」需求都套此模式，不要试图在 on-change 里补救

## 验证与归属
- 验证：会话 3b0f6cd2 结论明确「设 :limit=1 后再次选择走 on-exceed，不进入 on-change」，给出 handleExceed{ clearFiles + handleStart } 代码
- 涉及文件：zhi2-web-admin/src/components/FileUpload/index.vue、src/views/property/spFeeBill/components/import.vue、importUploadDialog.vue
- 所属项目：产品2.0
- 来源会话ID：3b0f6cd2-34d8-446f-830d-2c1d4d5eda2f
- 代码基线：94b86fa
